hypothesis: An NFL team with substantially more time since its previous regular-season start has a positive win-minus-closing-probability residual relative to ordinary-rest teams in the same week and home/away role; additional preparation/recovery may be imperfectly reflected in consensus prices.
distinction: Schedule-derived long rest, not verified official bye status. This is not a reversal/rescue of the failed NBA B2B or NFL rematch rules.

source.license: Publisher CC BY4.0 label; upstream rights not certified. Raw stays private; use existing authorized source receipt, do not download again.
source.benchmark: Publisher consensus proportional de-vig closing probability; not decision-time or offered executable odds.

prior_exposure.season: Entire2025season already inspected in the separate rematch study. Long-rest subgroup outcomes/counts/contrasts not computed or inspected for this protocol. No untouched holdout claim.
prior_exposure.reason: Retain earlier search-exposed-row exclusions for comparability; exclusion does not make inspected season independent.

feature.prior_start: Immediately previous strictly earlier regular-season start for each stable team ID, schedule only; no scores/odds/injuries define rest.
feature.bounds: Inclusive elapsed24hour-day bounds, not calendar dates.
feature.treated: One team per game iff its prior-start gap is12..18days and opponent gap5..9days. Both-long-rest, missing-prior and all other gaps ineligible for treatment.
feature.controls: Games where both teams have prior gaps5..9days. For home-treated strata use each control home team; for away-treated strata use control away team. Same control game may contribute to two venue strata; retain shared game/week dependence.

outcomes: Win indicator minus selected-team closing probability; p_home for home or1-p_home for away. Tied finals excluded from evaluated groups because exact tie pricing/settlement uncertified. First-game/missing-prior, search-exposed and ties reported separately.
primary: In each week×home-away stratum with both groups, mean treated residual minus mean control residual. Weight by treated count; sum(n_treated*contrast)/sum(n_treated). Strata lacking either group get zero weight and are reported; no substitute controls.

uncertainty.method: Circular3-week blocks over full1..18grid; sample6blocks per draw, preserving all roles/games within sampled week and recompute primary.
uncertainty.interval: 99% two-sided percentile using linear interpolation at(n-1)*q; report zero-weight skips.

decision: Descriptive lead only if contrast>=0.03 and lower99%>0; otherwise not_supported. Gate/minimum failure aborted/insufficient_data. No cutoff rescue/reverse rule.
multiplicity: One predeclared primary in this new long-rest family; Brier/group summaries descriptive only. All previous project families remain disclosed. No project-wide false-positive-control or independent-validation claim from this reused season; confirmation requires a separately registered independent/prospective sample.
outputs: all exclusions and comparable/zero-weight strata counts
limits: Closing calibration only, not ROI/CLV/causality or T-60 information. Long rest can reflect scheduling/travel/postponements rather than official bye; team/strength/calendar/injury confounding remains. Week blocks cannot eliminate team dependence. No model/pick promotion from any result.
next: Implement and test schedule blindness, home/away orientation, inclusive elapsed bounds, missing/tied/exposed exclusions, stratum weighting and deterministic bootstrap using synthetic fixtures before computing this subgroup. Preserve protocol bytes unchanged.
